hats.prompt: Edit this felt sauna crown hat into a worn-on-head game sprite. Preserve ivory felt wool texture, five playful crown points, dark emerald pompoms and fine gold stitched borders. Critical camera: straight-on front at eye level, looking slightly DOWN at the hat, not up inside it. The bottom front brim is a shallow curved narrow gold line, NO visible large dark oval interior, NO hollow bucket mouth facing viewer. Crown is rounded in 3D as if fitted tightly around a chimpanzee skull. Rear rim sits hidden behind head. Isolate ONLY the hat, no head, no skin, fully transparent background. Premium photorealistic wardrobe art, symmetric subtle natural fabric folds.
